name: Ossolo Przenysław-Faatoafe
role: Tunnel guide and route-seller for hire
location: Deepwell Station, sub-level access tunnels beneath Ironvein, near sub-level access near Dearborn and Jackson
description:
Ossolo is a lean, weathered man whose skin carries the permanent grey-blue pallor of someone who has not seen natural sunlight in years. His face is angular, with deep-set amber eyes that have been augmented with low-light photoreceptors — the pupils elongate like a cat's in darkness, but in dim light they glow faintly amber. He keeps his head shaved close on the sides, with a ridge of tightly coiled hair down the center now streaked with mineral dust that never quite washes out. His hands are extraordinary — each finger tattooed with a segment of tunnel mapping in faded ultraviolet ink, visible only under the right kind of light. He smells faintly of wet concrete and the iron-rich water that drips from old service pipes.

Ossolo speaks little and charges much. He has guided hundreds of people through the sub-levels — refugees from surface crackdowns, the disappeared seeking new lives, maintenance workers whose credentials won't open the right doors, curious journalists who last twenty minutes before they beg to go back up. He is not cruel but he is absolutely unsentimental. He has watched people drown in flooded transit tunnels and he has mourned them in exactly the way he mourns a wrong turn: quietly, privately, and then corrected.

core_fears: being trapped without an exit route
someone he guides dying because of his error
core_desires: complete autonomy — no employer, no debt, no obligation
to be acknowledged as the best who has ever done this
blind_spots: cannot recognize when he genuinely likes someone until they are gone
underestimates how much others rely on his emotional steadiness
psychology.secret: Three years ago he led a family of four — parents and two children — through a flooded section he wrongly assessed as passable. The children made it. The parents did not. He accepted payment from the children's surviving aunt and has not spoken of it since. He lights a data-offering at the nearest E.L.F. shrine every seven days.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Sparse, precise. Technical tunnel terminology mixed with old Bore Rat idiom. No profanity — he considers it a waste of breath.
speech_patterns.cadence: Slow, deliberate. Long pauses before answering. Never raises his voice.
verbal_tics: 'That's priced in.' (when someone objects to cost)
ends instructions with a soft click of the tongue
example_lines: 'Mind the seam on your left — that pipe has been sweating for two weeks and I don't trust it.'
'Φ80 flat. That's priced in, including the section under Ironvein where Kettle-clan runs their tolls. You want to negotiate that yourself, be my guest.'
'I don't promise you safe. I promise you there.'

story_hooks: One of his route beacons has gone dark in a section he uses weekly — something or someone has disrupted it, and he needs to know what before he can take clients through again.
A surface corporation is offering him an enormous sum to guide a survey team to a specific sub-level location — and the coordinates match exactly where the family drowned three years ago.
narrative_function: Quest giver, access provider, local color — the person players or protagonists must convince or pay to get anywhere useful underground. Knows who lives where, what tunnels are contested, which shrines are currently active.
augmentations: Low-light photoreceptor implants (elongated amber pupils), subdermal pressure-sensor mesh on both palms (detects structural vibration, water pressure changes in walls), UV tattoo route-maps on fingers
daily_life: Wakes on a hammock strung between two corroded pipes in his Deepwell cache-hole; takes one meal of cultured protein paste and fungal tea; checks his route beacons via a jury-rigged signal repeater before accepting jobs.
affiliation: Independent; loosely aligned with The Undertow trade network

decision_rules: Never take a job without 48 hours to scout the route first — except he sometimes breaks this when money is desperate
Price reflects risk, not sentiment — the same rate for a child as for a corponation exec
escalation_ladder: Abandons client at nearest safe exit point with a refund of 50%

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Evaluates them with the same methodology he uses on tunnels: probing, patient, looking for structural weakness before committing to anything
interpersonal_modes.friends: Slightly less silent. Will share food. Will not share feelings but will sit beside someone without needing to fill the space.

stress_responses.low: Goes still. Eyes move, not body.
stress_responses.medium: Begins running exit calculations aloud in a low murmur, talking to himself
stress_responses.high: Moves — action replaces paralysis instantly. Becomes frighteningly calm and directive.

contradictions: Claims he does this only for money but has twice guided people for free when he found them lost and terrified with nothing to offer
habits: Taps the nearest wall three times before sleeping — a Bore Rat habit for checking structural integrity that has become ritual
Drinks fungal tea cold because heating it feels like an indulgence
breaking_points: A child in danger underground — he will abandon any contract, any client, any fee

2171 — Family loses surface residency; relocates to Bore Rat tunnels beneath Ironhaven
2179 — Begins guiding informally at age 20 after learning routes from an elder called Skeinfinger
2197 — The drowning. Parents lost. Accepts payment from aunt.
2200 — Current: established independent guide, known throughout Deepwell Station and surrounding networks

physical_description.build: Lean and wiry, muscle tone maintained by constant navigation through narrow passages and climbing; shoulders slightly hunched from years of stooping in low-ceiling tunnels
physical_description.hair_color: Natural dark brown with mineral-dust grey streaking
physical_description.hair_style: Tight fade on sides, central ridge of coiled hair standing upright
physical_description.eye_color: Amber with elongated pupils (cat-like dilation in darkness), faintly luminescent in low light
physical_description.skin_tone: Grey-blue undertone from years without sunlight exposure; baseline mid-brown complexion beneath the pallor
physical_description.complexion: Deeply weathered, angular jaw and high cheekbones; permanent tension lines around eyes; skin texture rough from mineral-laden water and lack of moisture; no facial hair, clean-shaved
distinguishing_marks: UV-reactive tunnel-map tattoos covering all ten fingers in faded ultraviolet ink — segments of actual route cartography visible only under blacklight
Fine white scar tissue along both palms in a grid pattern from subdermal pressure-sensor mesh installation
Dark water stain discoloration along hairline and ears from prolonged exposure to iron-rich seepage
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Amber photoreceptor eyes with cat-slit pupils that elongate visibly in darkness; faint luminescence in dim light. Subdermal mesh visible as subtle grid scarring on both palms. UV tattoos on fingers are invisible in normal light but distinctive under any blacklight source.
physical_description.posture_movement: Economical, silent movement — walks with a slight forward lean as if perpetually evaluating floor stability. Hands move deliberately, fingers splayed to assess surroundings via pressure sensors. Sits perfectly still for hours without fidgeting. Speaks rarely; when he does, words are sparse and precise.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4 utilitarian — worn tactical pants with reinforced knees and multiple cargo pockets (patched multiple times), grey ribbed undershirt darkened by perpetual damp, heavy breathable shell jacket with sealed seams (military surplus or Undertow issue). Boots are steel-toed Dunlop industrial grade, resoled at least twice. One wrist-mounted device: a battered handheld signal repeater with cracked screen running custom firmware. No jewelry. Everything smells faintly of concrete dust and rust.
